title: Samsung TV will not power on
shortDescription: TV unresponsive with no standby light.
fullDescription:
Samsung TVs commonly fail to power on due to capacitor failures on the power supply board. The 'capacitor plague' on older models causes a clicking sound and refusal to start.

Newer QLED/Neo QLED models are more reliable but still suffer occasional PSU failures.

fixSteps.title: Verify outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Test outlet with another device.

fixSteps.title: Power drain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes, hold power 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Capacitor inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, check PSU for bulged capacitors.

whenToCallPro: PSU repair involves dangerous voltages - call pro unless experienced.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung TV won't turn on capacitor fix

faq.a: No - it indicates the PSU is trying and failing to start.

title: Tizen interface frozen or unresponsive
shortDescription: Smart Hub / Tizen stops responding to remote.
fullDescription:
Samsung Tizen interface can freeze due to corrupted cache, full storage, or app conflicts. A cold boot (full power drain) clears most cases.

For persistent issues, Smart Hub reset rebuilds the app environment without losing the system firmware.

fixSteps.title: Cold boot
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 60 seconds, replug.

fixSteps.title: Smart Hub reset
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Support > Self Diagnosis > Reset Smart Hub.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > Reset (last resort).

videoSearchQuery: Samsung Tizen frozen reset Smart Hub

faq.q: What does Reset Smart Hub do?
faq.a: Removes apps and account logins; doesn't change system firmware.

title: Anynet+ HDMI-CEC failure
shortDescription: Connected devices not auto-powering or controlling.
fullDescription:
Anynet+ is Samsung's HDMI-CEC. Failures usually trace to the feature being disabled after firmware updates, or partner devices having CEC off.

Q950/Neo QLED 8K sets with One Connect boxes can need additional power-cycle steps.

fixSteps.title: Enable Anynet+
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > External Device Manager > Anynet+ ON.

fixSteps.title: Enable partner CEC
fixSteps.instruction: Bravia Sync, SimpLink, Viera Link, etc.

fixSteps.title: Re-handshake
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle all devices, TV last.

faq.a: Yes - it's standard HDMI-CEC under Samsung's brand name.

title: HDMI input shows no signal
shortDescription: TV not detecting source on selected port.
fullDescription:
Samsung TVs show 'No Signal' when source isn't outputting, HDMI handshake fails, or Input Signal Plus (4K@120Hz, HDR) is required but not enabled on that port.

QLED and Neo QLED need Input Signal Plus enabled for full HDMI 2.1 features.

fixSteps.title: Switch input
fixSteps.instruction: Press Source, select correct HDMI.

fixSteps.title: Enable Input Signal Plus
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > External Device Manager > Input Signal Plus ON for that port.

fixSteps.title: Test cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use Ultra High Speed HDMI cable for 4K/120 sources.

affectedModels: All Samsung TVs, especially QLED/Neo QLED
whenToCallPro: Only if HDMI port has physical damage.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung TV no signal HDMI fix

faq.a: Samsung's term for HDMI 2.0/2.1 enhanced bandwidth modes.

title: HDCP handshake failure
shortDescription: Protected content won't play through HDMI.
fullDescription:
Samsung QLED/Neo QLED HDCP failures appear as black screen or 'HDCP unauthorized device' messages. Most often caused by AVR pass-through breaking the chain.

The One Connect cable on Q-series can also cause HDCP errors when bent or damaged.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV, AVR, source 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Bypass AVR
fixSteps.instruction: Connect source directly to TV.

fixSteps.title: Replace One Connect cable
fixSteps.instruction: On Q-series, bent fiber cable causes intermittent HDCP errors.

faq.q: What is the One Connect cable?
faq.a: Samsung's fiber-optic cable connecting Q-series TV to its One Connect box.

title: Netflix won't load on Samsung TV
shortDescription: Stored Netflix data needs to be refreshed.
fullDescription:
Netflix error UI-800-3 indicates stored data on the device needs refreshing. On Samsung Tizen TVs, this is fixed by signing out and back in, or reinstalling the app.

Does not indicate a hardware issue.

fixSteps.title: Sign out
fixSteps.instruction: Open Netflix > Get Help > Sign Out > Yes.

fixSteps.title: Restart TV
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 60 seconds, replug.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall Netflix
fixSteps.instruction: Apps > Settings > Netflix > Reinstall.

faq.q: Will I lose my watch progress?
faq.a: No - progress is stored on Netflix servers, not the TV.

title: Halos or blooming around bright objects
shortDescription: Light bleeds around bright objects on dark backgrounds.
fullDescription:
Blooming is a characteristic of LCD/QLED with local dimming - bright objects on dark backgrounds show light halos. Neo QLED Mini-LED reduces this dramatically.

Not a defect for non-OLED LCDs; can be reduced with Local Dimming settings.

fixSteps.title: Set Local Dimming High
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Picture > Expert Settings > Local Dimming > High.

fixSteps.title: Lower Backlight
fixSteps.instruction: Reduces brightness ceiling and halo intensity.

fixSteps.title: Disable Contrast Enhancer
fixSteps.instruction: Reduces aggressive boosting that exaggerates blooming.

faq.a: No - it's a characteristic of LCD with local dimming. OLED has none.

title: Vertical colored lines on screen
shortDescription: Panel or T-CON failure causing colored lines.
fullDescription:
Vertical lines on Samsung TVs typically come from T-CON board failure or damaged ribbon cables between T-CON and panel. Lines appearing on the menu confirm internal display fault.

Reseating ribbons sometimes resolves it; otherwise T-CON or panel replacement is needed.

fixSteps.title: Confirm on menu
fixSteps.instruction: If lines appear on Samsung menu, fault is internal.

fixSteps.title: Reseat T-CON ribbons
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, gently reseat ribbon connectors.

fixSteps.title: Replace T-CON
fixSteps.instruction: Order matching T-CON board by part number.

whenToCallPro: If reseating doesn't help and you're not comfortable replacing boards.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung TV vertical lines T-CON fix

faq.a: Often not - panel cost approaches new TV price.

title: Samsung Smart Remote unresponsive
fullDescription:
Samsung's modern Solar Remote uses Bluetooth and IR. When pairing breaks the voice/Smart features stop; basic IR may still work. Solar charging issues can also leave the battery flat.

Re-pair by holding Return + Play/Pause for 3 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Charge solar remote
fixSteps.instruction: Place under bright light or use USB-C 30+ minutes.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Point at TV, hold Return + Play/Pause 3 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Use SmartThings app
fixSteps.instruction: Backup remote via the SmartThings phone app.

videoSearchQuery: Samsung Smart Remote not working pair

faq.q: How long should solar remote charge?
faq.a: Initial charge takes hours; normal use top-up via room light.

title: Tizen / firmware update did not complete
shortDescription: OTA update fails to download or install.
fullDescription:
Samsung Tizen updates can fail due to weak network, full storage, or staged rollouts.

USB recovery using firmware downloaded from Samsung Support is the reliable fallback.

fixSteps.title: Wired connection
fixSteps.instruction: Use Ethernet for stable update.

fixSteps.title: Free storage
fixSteps.instruction: Remove unused apps.

fixSteps.title: USB update
fixSteps.instruction: Download from Samsung Support, copy unzipped folder to USB root, plug in.

faq.q: Where do I find the firmware?
faq.a: Samsung Support site - search exact model number, download Upgrade File USB type.

title: No audio through HDMI ARC/eARC soundbar
shortDescription: Soundbar connected but TV plays no audio through it.
fullDescription:
Samsung TVs commonly have eARC dropout issues with soundbars (both Samsung and third-party). Causes include format mismatch, Anynet+ misconfiguration, or eARC needing to be enabled separately.

Using the dedicated ARC port and a Premium High Speed cable resolves most cases.

fixSteps.title: Check ARC port
fixSteps.instruction: Use only the HDMI port labeled ARC/eARC.

fixSteps.title: Enable eARC
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Sound > Expert Settings > HDMI-eARC Mode > On.

fixSteps.title: Set Audio Format
fixSteps.instruction: If Atmos issues, try Auto then PCM.

videoSearchQuery: Samsung TV ARC no sound fix

faq.q: What's the difference between ARC and eARC?
faq.a: eARC supports lossless and Atmos; ARC is limited to compressed formats.

title: Audio plays but screen is black
shortDescription: Backlight or panel issue with audio working.
fullDescription:
On Samsung LCD/QLED, black screen with audio is usually backlight failure - LED strips burned out. Use the flashlight test to confirm: if a faint image shows, the panel works but isn't lit.

Neo QLED Mini-LED can show partial blackouts where individual zones fail.

fixSteps.title: Flashlight test
fixSteps.instruction: Shine bright light on screen at angle - faint image = backlight failure.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes, hold power 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Backlight repair
fixSteps.instruction: LED strip replacement requires panel disassembly.

whenToCallPro: Backlight repair is invasive - usually pro-only.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung TV black screen sound fix

faq.q: How long do LED backlights last?
faq.a: Typically 6-10 years; can fail earlier with high brightness use.
